content.heading: Arbitration agreement
content.text: An arbitration agreement is an agreement by the parties to submit to arbitration all or certain disputes which have arisen or which may arise between them in respect of a defined legal relationship, whether contractual or not. An arbitration agreement may be in the form of an arbitration clause in a contract or in the form of a separate agreement. It shall be in writing. Writing includes an exchange of statements of claim and defence in which the existence of the agreement is alleged by one party and not denied by the other, and communication by electronic means as enacted.
